about: On the Lumbridge spawn with 99 Fletching and Herblore and what the Artisan 2 steps make things from: crossbow parts, unfinished and finished bolts, gems for bolt tips, javelin tips and shafts (A1), and a super combat and stamina potion's ingredients (A2a).
notes: For trying the Artisan 2 steps by hand (A1: crossbows, bolts, bolt tips and javelins). Limbs on a stock with the hammer held, then a crossbow string; a feather on the unfinished bolts (10 a click; the All Settings toggle 'Make-X for darts and bolts' opens the box instead); the chisel on an opal; the opal tips on the bronze bolts; the javelin tips on the shafts. A2a: the torstol on a super potion (all three held) for a super combat, the amylase on the super energy(4) for a stamina(4). The loadout is ours.
